Title: 498018-2026: France – Architectural, engineering and planning services – 26M0211AOO - PROJECT MANAGEMENT FOR THE WORKS TO DEMOLISH THE SLAB OF THE M14 BRIDGE BETWEEN CASTELGINEST AND SAINT-ALBAN AND HYDROMORPHOLOGICAL RESTORATION OF THE HERS MORT
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: The project concerns engineering services for the removal of a bridge base slab and accompanying hydromorphological measures – therefore generally relevant for structural and civil works. Deduction because it is demolition (no new construction/no large span) and the location is in France (outside the DACH region), therefore only moderately prioritised.
titel: Planning services for the removal of the base slab of the M14 bridge between Castelginest and Saint-Alban and hydromorphological restoration of the Hers-Mort
kurzbeschreibung: Planning for bridge deconstruction and river restoration to improve flood protection.
umfang: The subject is the removal of the base slab at the M14 bridge structure over the Hers-Mort between Saint-Alban and Castelginest, as well as accompanying hydromorphological restoration measures in the area of influence. The base slab is to be removed at the bridge location over a minimum width of 13 m and a height of 1 m. The background is insufficient hydraulic performance of the watercourse cross-section, with flood risks for 120 built units in the case of a 30-year flood and up to 380 in the case of a 100-year flood.
leistungen: Full project management planning services (Maîtrise d’oeuvre) with AVP, PRO, ACT, VISA, DET and AOR as well as additional services: diagnosis, hydraulic study, cost-benefit analysis, OPC, topographical surveying and geotechnical services.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• No new construction or sophisticated bridge structure, but predominantly removal of a base slab and accompanying hydraulic engineering measures.
• Structural complexity and architectural or structural degree of innovation appear low.
• The scope of services does include classic planning phases, but the focus is strongly on hydraulics, renaturation, surveying and geotechnics.
• Only of limited suitability for sbp, as bridge expertise is available, but the focus is not on a complex structure.
• The complete planning scope including construction supervision is positive, but overall the strategic relevance is low.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the tender. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of information on the structural dimensions of the bridge, demolition method, watercourse development, bank protection, traffic management and scope of renaturation. Based on the described intervention, a rough estimate in the low single-digit to mid-million range would be conceivable, but not sufficiently reliable.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee explicitly stated. Without reliable construction costs and without detailed information on optional tranches, no serious fee estimate is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Proof of professional liability insurance; self-declarations on exclusion grounds and employment obligations; turnover figures for the last three financial years; OPQIBI; list of key services over the last three years with amount, date and client; 4 references from the last 5 years for comparable projects involving repair, strengthening or securing of foundations of masonry structures; AIPR certificate; designation of the personnel deployed and their professional qualifications.
zuschlagskriterien: Technical value 40%, quality of references 20%, price of services 40%.
auftraggeber: Toulouse Métropole, Direction de la commande publique, 1 rue Jacques Matthieu Delpech, 31100 Toulouse, France; contact person: MOUDENC Jean-Luc; e-mail: correspondre@aws-france.com; website: https://www.toulouse-metropole.fr/
notes: Open procedure. Contract start expected on 21.09.2026, duration 40 months. Optional tranches are planned as well as possible award of similar services in the future. Electronic submission required, procedure language French.
